confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge and the supplied city context; live menus, booking pages, and listings were not inspected. Restaurant and cafe anchors are moderately reliable. Cocktail and wine were set from the draft-beer anchor (about five and four times its price) because direct bar-price knowledge is weaker. Hostel and hotel anchors are least certain: they assume central districts, July demand, and taxes and fees included, and they vary widely by area and date.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: mainland China tier-one city price levels, using general knowledge of Beijing's central visitor districts (for example Dongcheng, Xicheng and Sanlitun) for dining and lodging. No single comparable city was used as a direct substitute.
